parsed.explanation: Visitor-facing exposure is severe: entry screening and document rules can refuse, delay, or detain trans applicants over marker/presentation mismatch, with possible lifetime fraud findings; travelers report passports blocked or confiscated. Government facility bans in many states, some criminalizing use, create universal outing/arrest risk; one documented restroom arrest included birth-sex custody. Immigration/correctional custody reports hormone removal, forced-labour and sexual abuse. Court challenges and some state protections create uncertainty, but active restrictions and state enforcement dominate, keeping this in lower High Risk.
